title: One row of Customers/{customer_id}/filings/presentations/ip-metrics.jsonl
description: One metric read from one slide of an investor presentation. The eleven required fields are the contract with hfc-kpi-extraction; the optional fields add provenance and never replace a required one. Domain rules that a schema cannot express (unit per metric, integer counts, parent naming, duplicates, the restructured-book exclusion, AUM == loan book) are in scripts/validate_ip_metrics.py.

period.description: The period the VALUE covers: the discrete quarter for a flow, the quarter whose end date the balance is 'as at' for a stock. H1/9M/FY only when the deck gives no discrete quarter and none can be derived; then period_basis says so.

metric.description: A key from references/metric-synonyms.json (branches, employees, disbursements, aum, loan_book, off_book_aum, sell_down_volume, buy_out_volume, aum_mix_*, avg_ticket_size, avg_ltv, yield, cost_of_funds, spread, nim).

value.description: In the unit named by 'unit'. null only with status not_disclosed or no_off_book.

document.description: Data-room path or file name of the deck the figure was read from.

slide.description: 1-based slide (PDF page) number. null only with status not_disclosed or no_off_book.

note.description: Empty string when there is nothing to say. Required content when approximate, from_parent, nil, not_disclosed, no_off_book, derived, or a non-quarter period.

status.description: Absent means reported. nil: the deck shows nil / '-' / 0 for the metric. not_disclosed: searched and not in the deck. no_off_book: AUM equals the loan book so no sell down is found (rulebook). derived: a discrete quarter computed from cumulative figures in the same deck.

period_basis.description: What the value covers. Absent means quarter for flows and as_at for stocks.

basis.description: What was counted, for metrics whose label varies: branches|locations|touchpoints|districts|states for 'branches'; on_roll|off_roll|total|unspecified for 'employees'; aum|loan_book|disbursements for a mix percentage.

source_label.description: The label exactly as printed on the slide.

source_value.description: The number as printed, before unit conversion.

parent_document.description: For from_parent rows: the parent company's name and deck, e.g. 'Example Finance Ltd investor presentation Q2 FY26'.

carried_from_period.description: On a not_disclosed row for branches/employees: the period of the previous IP value offered for carry-forward.
